topics.lesson_subject: VRRP destination-route tracking: fail over when the gateway is alive but upstream reachability is lost

topics.remediation_path: Enable VRRP/VMAC on all members, set a meaningful tracked destination, validate backup path/preemption, and respect model/license constraints

topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: two switches share VIP/VMAC; tracked upstream destination drives priority reduction and role transition
